in_sanskrit.name: Gomed
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Mountain born
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Gomed एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Gomaya', which means 'born on a mountain'. This name is associated with strength, resilience, and a connection to nature.
